import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch, MagicMock
from your_module import chemist_service, symptom_service, patient_service

class TestChemistService(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_query_chemist(self):
        chemist_id = 123  # Removed ungrounded value
        name = "Chemist Name"  # Removed ungrounded value
        address = "123 Main St"  # Removed ungrounded value
        contact_details = "123-456-7890"  # Removed ungrounded value
        result = chemist_service.query_chemist(chemist_id)
        self.assertEqual(result['chemist_id'], chemist_id)
        self.assertEqual(result['name'], name)
        self.assertEqual(result['address'], address)
        self.assertEqual(result['contact_details'], contact_details)

    def test_query_non_existent_chemist(self):
        chemist_id = 123  # Removed ungrounded value
        with patch('your_module.chemist_service.query_chemist') as mock_query:
            mock_query.return_value = None
            result = chemist_service.query_chemist(chemist_id)
            self.assertIsNone(result)

    def test_delete_chemist(self):
        chemist_id = 123  # Removed ungrounded value
        with patch('your_module.chemist_service.delete_chemist') as mock_delete:
            mock_delete.return_value = True
            result = chemist_service.delete_chemist(chemist_id)
            self.assertTrue(result)

    def test_modify_chemist(self):
        chemist_id = 123  # Removed ungrounded value
        name = "New Chemist Name"
        address = "New Address"
        contact_details = "New Contact Details"
        with patch('your_module.chemist_service.modify_chemist') as mock_modify:
            mock_modify.return_value = True
            result = chemist_service.modify_chemist(chemist_id, name, address, contact_details)
            self.assertTrue(result)

    def test_add_symptom(self):
        symptom_code = "New Symptom Code"
        symptom_description = "New Symptom Description"
        with patch('your_module.symptom_service.add_symptom') as mock_add:
            mock_add.return_value = True
            result = symptom_service.add_symptom(symptom_code, symptom_description)
            self.assertTrue(result)

    def test_edit_symptom(self):
        symptom_code = "New Symptom Code"
        symptom_description = "New Symptom Description"
        with patch('your_module.symptom_service.edit_symptom') as mock_edit:
            mock_edit.return_value = True
            result = symptom_service.edit_symptom(symptom_code, symptom_description)
            self.assertTrue(result)

    def test_delete_symptom(self):
        symptom_code = "New Symptom Code"
        with patch('your_module.symptom_service.delete_symptom') as mock_delete:
            mock_delete.return_value = True
            result = symptom_service.delete_symptom(symptom_code)
            self.assertTrue(result)

    def test_register_patient(self):
        patient_id = 123  # Removed ungrounded value
        name = "Patient Name"
        age = 30
        sex = "Male"
        address = "123 Main St"
        contact_details = "123-456-7890"
        with patch('your_module.patient_service.register_patient') as mock_register:
            mock_register.return_value = True
            result = patient_service.register_patient(name, age, sex, address, contact_details)
            self.assertTrue(result)

    def test_update_patient_profile(self):
        patient_id = 123  # Removed ungrounded value
        name = "New Patient Name"
        age = 31
        sex = "Female"
        address = "New Address"
        contact_details = "New Contact Details"
        with patch('your_module.patient_service.update_patient_profile') as mock_update:
            mock_update.return_value = True
            result = patient_service.update_patient_profile(patient_id, name, age, sex, address, contact_details)
            self.assertTrue(result)

    def test_update_patient_consultation_request(self):
        patient_id = 123  # Removed ungrounded value
        consultation_request = "New Consultation Request"
        with patch('your_module.patient_service.update_patient_consultation_request') as mock_update:
            mock_update.return_value = True
            result = patient_service.update_patient_consultation_request(patient_id, consultation_request)
            self.assertTrue(result)

    def test_update_patient_appointment_request(self):
        patient_id = 123  # Removed ungrounded value
        appointment_request = "New Appointment Request"
        with patch('your_module.patient_service.update_patient_appointment_request') as mock_update:
            mock_update.return_value = True
            result = patient_service.update_patient_appointment_request(patient_id, appointment_request)
            self.assertTrue(result)

    def test_update_patient_prescription(self):
        patient_id = 123  # Removed ungrounded value
        prescription = "New Prescription"
        with patch('your_module.patient_service.update_patient_prescription') as mock_update:
            mock_update.return_value = True
            result = patient_service.update_patient_prescription(patient_id, prescription)
            self.assertTrue(result)

    def test_update_patient_invoice(self):
        patient_id = 123  # Removed ungrounded value
        invoice = "New Invoice"
        with patch('your_module.patient_service.update_patient_invoice') as mock_update:
            mock_update.return_value = True
            result = patient_service.update_patient_invoice(patient_id, invoice)
            self.assertTrue(result)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
